author: Minecraft
description:
Mysterious rifts are opening across the Overworld... but where do they lead? To the Sift – a new dimension coming to Minecraft Dungeons II. Gear up and team up to journey into uncharted lands and face threats unlike anything you've fought before. Discover new ways to customize your loadout and playstyle as you prepare for your toughest battle yet. Do you have what it takes to brave the Sift?

Minecraft Dungeons II arrives on September 29, 2026! Pre-order now and get the exclusive Twisted cape, Twisted Chicken pet, and two hero skins: https://aka.ms/DungeonsII
